whenToUse: Status and severity labels in solid, light and outline tones for success, warning, info and errors
Counts and short tags such as an unread number or a New marker, sized to the text around them
Compact chips pairing a label with an icon, a dot, an avatar, a flag or a remove control, or acting as a link

whenNotToUse.when: An action that saves, opens or submits a form when pressed
Helper text revealed when a control is hovered or focused
A finished KPI or profile tile with a trend or status chip as one detail

agentNotes: Import `Badge` from `@/components/reui/badge`; the shadcn `Badge` of the same name lacks `size`, `radius` and the success, info and warning variants
The default `radius` follows the style, square in lyra and sera and a pill in maia, luma and rhea; `radius` full gives a pill in every style
